title: What happens if you accidentally move your ball on the green?
question: If you accidentally move your ball on the green, like while taking a practice swing too close to it, what must you do next?

choices.text: Play the ball from its new position, no penalty
Replace the ball to its original spot, no penalty
Replace the ball and add a penalty stroke
Leave the ball and skip your turn

explanation: If you accidentally move your ball on the green, there is no penalty but you must put it back to its original spot before continuing.
imagePrompt: A teenage girl golfer accidentally nudges her ball on the green with her putter, then carefully puts it back in its original place.
imageAlt: Girl golfer replaces her golf ball on the green after moving it accidentally.
